# Ticketmaster

Ticketmaster provides APIs for event discovery, inventory management, and ticketing solutions.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ticketmaster/.

## Actions

- **Get Event Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific event by id.
- **Get Events** (read-only): Retrieve a list of events matching specified filters.
- **Get Venues** (read-only): Retrieve a list of venues based on specified criteria.
- **Get Attraction Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific attraction by id.
- **Get Classification Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific classification.
- **Get Classifications** (read-only): Retrieve all event classifications.
- **Get Genre Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific genre.
- **Get Segment Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific segment.
- **Get Subgenre Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific subgenre.
- **Get Suggestions** (read-only): Retrieve auto-complete suggestions for search queries.
- **Get Ticketmaster Attractions** (read-only): Retrieve a list of attractions.
- **Get Venue Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific venue by id.
